summary: Join our comprehensive training on Digital Banking Fraud and Cybercrime Investigation. Equip yourself with essential skills to tackle modern financial threats.
lede: Digital banking fraud training helps financial-services professionals detect suspicious activity and investigate cybercrime cases. It covers recognizing channel-specific red flags, reviewing transaction data and logs, preserving evidence, and reconstructing events. Participants also practise interviewing stakeholders, documenting findings, escalating cases, and using lessons learned to strengthen controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly deal with fraud risk, suspicious activities, or cyber incidents in digital banking.
audience: Fraud risk managers and fraud prevention officers
Cybersecurity and information security officers in financial
Customer service and contact center managers
Risk and governance professionals in banks, MFIs
Law enforcement and cybercrime unit officers
modules: Digital Banking Fraud Landscape and Typologies
Channels, Attack Vectors, and Red Flags
Digital Evidence, Logs, and Transaction Trails
Social Engineering, Identity Theft, and Account Takeover
Incident Response, Escalation, and Case Closure
Reporting, Presenting Findings, and Building a Fraud-Aware Culture
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of digital banking operations and basic fraud prevention measures. Prior experience in fraud management or cybersecurity roles is beneficial but not mandatory.
topics: Digital financial services, payments & fintech risk
